description:
Managed in Partnership with Skmana Ski and Snowshoe Club Society, the cross country ski trail network offers over 11 km of track set classic ski trails surrounding beautiful wetlands and intimate twin lakes.

Visit Skmana Ski and Snoeshoe Club's website for current winter conditions and other updates.
directions:
Located about an hour East of Kamloops.
